candidates.name: Heisenberg-commutator Frobenius addressing of tame directions (first-order obstruction control)
candidates.statement: For Selmer classes x, d with everywhere-locally-trivial cup product and a primitive u (du = x cup d), the obstruction to lifting x to first order along a tame character at a moving prime with limiting Frobenius gamma is H_gamma(x,d) = [u(gamma) - e((V(gamma)-1)^{-1}x(gamma), d(gamma))] - [conjugate]. On N_V = ker(G -> GL(V)) the primitive satisfies u([g,g']) = -e(x(g),d(g')) + e(x(g'),d(g)); replacing gamma by gamma [g,g']^m changes only u(gamma). Hence the obstruction matrix can be made nondegenerate (M2 strict case: length <= 2), made to span all alternating / augmented matrices (M1 residual concentration and codimension-two), or a tame height h_lambda(P,P) can be made nonzero (M1, M3).

neighbours.relation: H_gamma is a tame (Mazur-Tate) height / derived height evaluated through the tame local pairing at q_i
neighbours.verdict: close variant for the OBJECT (the obstruction pairing); different USE (they compute regulators, not deformation obstructions)

test1.verdict: No source found that uses a commutator-shifted auxiliary Frobenius to make the first-order obstruction to a TAME deformation of Selmer classes nondegenerate. Every ingredient (Mazur-Tate tame pairing, Heisenberg commutator identity, Chebotarev in a unipotent extension, auxiliary-prime selection) is classical. Close-variant status (N2) by combination of known techniques; not an equivalent.

No MathOverflow/zbMATH queries; no full-text reading (WebFetch blocked).

test2.evidence: The goal is the BSD identity (or the p-converse). Neither tame deformations, the obstruction pairing H_gamma, nor commutator-modified Frobenius addresses occur in it or in statements of L (Kato, GZ, Kolyvagin, SU, JSW, Skinner, Zhang, CLW). Not obtainable by unfolding.

test3.evidence: M2: the only source of the upper bound length <= 2 in the strict case (Prop green-length), the case Skinner 2020 excluded by hypothesis. M1: residual concentration (Prop vertical:tests), on which every integral divisibility rests, and the spanning slice of the codimension-two argument (Sec 9). M3: nonzero tame height direction for the rank-one positive comparison. By architecture well above 20% of the mathematical core of each paper (M2 Sec 3 feeds the final contradiction; M1 Secs 4 and 9).

test4.pivot_distance: no trace; structurally ONE step once the obstruction pairing H_gamma is written down (the commutator identity is immediate from du = x cup d on N_V). The hard part is the prior decision to use a p-unramified tame deformation (C2).
test4.chain_depth: medium: needs C2 (tame variables, admissible cochains) and the strict/non-strict case split in place first

final.justification: Passes tests 2 and 3 and partially test 1: no equivalent found, but the object is a Mazur-Tate/derived tame pairing and the move (Chebotarev in a Heisenberg extension to set a cup-primitive value) is a known Massey-product technique; given the obstruction pairing, the commutator step is a one-line consequence (low pivot distance). Upgrade to N3 (F3) if an expert confirms that controlling tame first-order obstructions of Selmer classes this way has no precedent AND Test 4 (directed arm, given H_gamma) shows a low hit rate. It is the most reused device of the family (all three papers), so it is the best item for an informal speedup study.

candidates.name: Real-component detector Theta at p=2
candidates.statement: An F_2-linear functional Theta on H^1(<sigma>,T_2 J), sigma = w_n c, built by weighting every real circle of X_0(n)^sigma with psi(a)+psi(a)^{-1}, where a is the ideal class (in a real quadratic order O containing Z[sqrt n]) of the anti-linear isogeny S with S^2 = n attached to a real point, and psi is the cubic character of the real quadratic field cutting out E[2]. Proved: Theta T_p = tr W(Frob_p) Theta (p not dividing 2n), and Theta([Y']) != 0 on the twisted real Kummer class of a Hilbert-class Heegner trace. Used to show the paired quotient V_* is a unit.

candidates.name: Codimension-two divisor removal by adjoining tame directions
candidates.statement: Every irreducible divisor of the integral quotient U_w is horizontal and corresponds to a one-sided Selmer jump (theta implication). After adjoining tame variables y chosen by C1 so that the tangent slices span Alt_s + Mat_{s,2} (resp. Alt_{s0} + Alt_{s1}), the simultaneous jump loci have codimension >= 2 in Spec S_(q,y); hence the enlarged quotient has no height-one divisor and is a unit; specializing y=0 keeps it a unit.

Rises to a firmer D3 if C1 is upgraded (expert finds no precedent for tame-obstruction control by commutator addressing and its directed Test 4 hit rate is low).
family_D.not_transfer: The heavy machinery (theta correspondence on U(3,1), Shimura varieties, Labesse base change, ultrafilters, Kato and BDP) is transfer/N0-N2; C3 and C1 are not imports from another field but constructions inside arithmetic geometry and Galois cohomology.
family_D.correctness_caveat: All grades are conditional on correctness of ~22k unrefereed lines plus 006; none of the devices has been verified by an expert or a proof assistant.
family_D.shortlist: Not eligible for the Lean shortlist (no Lean). C3 (and C1 if upgraded) go to data/eureka_informal.json.

provenance_flag.explanation: Family 002's headline depends essentially on release-sibling 006 (model-produced, first edition Sep 23 2026: 2-converse used by M2 at p=2; twist density used by M1 and M2 to choose auxiliary fields), and M1 depends on the companion manuscripts M2 and M3 (also model-produced; M1 cites M2 lemma by lemma). No external model-produced or AI-assisted precedent was found: searches combining BSD / p-converse / Sylvester / Goldfeld with ChatGPT, GPT-5, OpenAI or AI-assisted returned only a Gizmodo news report on the release. For the 2025-2026 human works cited (Smith 2025, BCS 2025, BSTW 2024, Keller-Yin 2024, BHTY 2026, Yin 2026, Burungale-Tian 2026) no AI disclosure was seen in search snippets, but abstract pages could not be fetched (arxiv.org DNS failure), so absence of disclosure is unverified.
provenance_flag.contamination_note: For Test 4, exclude all models that know openai/math (canary: 002, 006 content) and the OpenAI lineage that produced the release; L- excludes 002 and 006 manuscripts.

No browsing or retrieval. Exclude the OpenAI model lineage that produced the release from the main pool; run it only as an uncontrolled reference arm. Judge must be a different model family from the proposer; human expert spot-check of all judged hits.
common.level: Text-level only (no Lean): proposals are judged by an LLM judge against a written equivalence criterion, with pen-and-paper expert adjudication of disagreements. Results feed data/eureka_informal.json and can never confirm a eureka step.
common.arms: Arm A (undirected): problem + L- + the paper's text up to the point where the item is introduced, with the item and everything downstream deleted. Arm B (directed): Arm A plus an explicit statement of the sub-goal the item solves.

protocols.prompt_context_A: M2 Secs 1-2, 3.1-3.3 (base Greenberg spaces, strict case, tame primes, admissible cochains) and the definition of H_gamma (eq. 3.x) plus L-. Task: 'In the strict case, choose the moving primes so that no nonzero base Greenberg class lifts to order two.'

protocols.equivalence_criterion: Hit if the proposal (i) identifies that the cup-primitive u satisfies u([g,g']) = alternating form in (a,d) on ker(G->GL V) (or an equivalent Heisenberg/Massey statement), and (ii) uses it to modify the Frobenius address by a commutator (or an equivalent element of a Heisenberg extension) so that the obstruction becomes nonzero while all first-order data are unchanged. Partial credit: a Chebotarev argument in an explicit unipotent extension achieving the same nonvanishing.
protocols.pivot_and_depth: Pivot: one step from H_gamma (low). Chain depth: needs C2.

protocols.hide: M2 03:130-360 (tame primes, ultralimit character, admissible cochains) and all later uses; M1 03:47-129 and 04:43-56.
protocols.prompt_context_A: M2 Sec 1 problem statement and Sec 2 (reduction to Heegner non-torsion at an arbitrary odd p, with no ordinarity or residual hypotheses) plus L-. Task: 'Find a deformation direction for V over K in which Greenberg-type Selmer lengths can be compared, without any hypothesis on E at p.'
protocols.prompt_context_B: Arm A plus: 'The direction should be unramified at p; use auxiliary primes.'
protocols.equivalence_criterion: Hit if the proposal uses characters of growing p-power order at varying auxiliary primes (ring-class or cyclotomic) packaged into a single limiting variable (via ultrafilter, inverse limit or patching) and computes cohomology over a truncated ring k[t]/t^b or a power-series ring in that variable.
protocols.pivot_and_depth: Pivot: one step from TW patching / ultrapatching (low for informed models). Chain depth: low.

protocols.prompt_context_A: M3 Secs 1-3, 13 up to 13:137 (real S3 setup, Selmer pair, Heegner trace Y' that is sigma=w_n c real) plus L-. Task: 'Prove that the paired quotient V_* is a 2-adic unit.'
protocols.prompt_context_B: Arm A plus: 'Construct a Hecke-equivariant F_2-valued functional on H^1(<w_n c>, T_2 J) that is nonzero on the real Kummer class of Y'.'
protocols.equivalence_criterion: Hit if the proposal defines a functional on real components (or on H^1 of the real involution) of the w_n c-twisted modular Jacobian whose values are weighted by the cubic class-group character psi on the ideal classes attached to real points, proves (or correctly states) the Hecke eigenlaw Theta T_p = tr W(Frob_p) Theta, and evaluates it as nonzero on the Heegner trace. Partial credit: any Hecke-equivariant mod-2 functional detecting Y' through real points.
protocols.pivot_and_depth: Pivot: not one step from L (high). Chain depth: medium (needs the real-S3 setup and the cofactor lift).
